label: Diagram 3.6
caption: Diagram 3.6 Floor type 1 – floor penetrations
description: A section headed "Diagram 3.6 Floor type 1 – floor penetrations", marked "SECTION" at the lower right. A masonry wall of cross-hatched blocks stands above and below a concrete floor slab with a speckled pattern. To the right of the wall, pipes wrapped in mineral wool run vertically through the floor inside an enclosure; labels read "Lag pipes with mineral wool" and "Enclosure". Below the slab, a ceiling on small crossed battens meets the enclosure, and the label "Seal with tape or sealant" points to that junction.
first_draft: The image shows two sections. The right-hand part, headed "Diagram 3.6 Floor type 1 – floor penetrations", is a section through a floor. A horizontal, cross-hatched floor slab is crossed by a vertical, cross-hatched wall. Two parallel vertical lines pass through the floor; a label "Lag pipes with mineral wool" points to them. A vertical member at the wall-and-floor junction is labelled "Enclosure", and a line there is labelled "Seal with tape or sealant". Small open triangles are scattered over the slab, and "SECTION" appears at the lower right. The left-hand part is a section, cut off at the top, showing an "External cavity wall" of vertical brick pattern, a vertical cross-hatched element, and a horizontal floor with a wavy line and a row of small circles. A dimension arrow reads "Minimum 300mm", and "Timber batten" points to a horizontal line; "SECTION" is at the lower right. Below this part is running text giving the heading "Junctions with an external cavity wall with timber frame inner leaf" and clause 3.36 a.
